title: Guillaume was our guide. He is very good and extremely knowledgeable about “ his City”. We found him outstanding.
text: Walking thru the old town was great our guide’s knowledge made the walk much more educational. He knew many of the best view points - ideal for camera buffs. His insight while in the chapel and the citadel enriched the experience.
author: Barrie_R

title: Fantastic tour with amazing tour guide
text: Highly recommended! Our tour guide, Blanca, was very knowledgeable about the history and architecture of the city. She tailor-made our tour just for us and answered all our questions. We fell in love with Granada thanks to the way Blanca presented it. Best tour guide! Thank you for a wonderful time.
author: zkamis
